crossRefs.note: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’ ”
Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here.” ’
translations.bsb: And now you say, ‘Go tell your master that Elijah is here!’
translations.kjv: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
translations.asv: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
